clue.text: Carries on with summaries

definitions.meaning: continues after a pause, a verb in the third person
brief accounts of the main points, as on a CV or at the end of a report

explanation.surface: Someone keeps going with their précis writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up again after a break is a verb sense; the noun sense is a brief outline, as in a job applicant's CV.

clue.text: Person tossing food — there are many on TV!

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is a person who sells or acts for a firm
eats is informal for food

explanation.surface: A diner flinging food about, with a wry aside about television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tossing' only joins the pieces in the surface picture. REP is a common short form for a sales representative.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcasters fill schedules with reruns of old programmes, so there are plenty on television.

clue.text: Being stifled he stormed out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the words he stormed are reworked, as in something gone out of order

explanation.surface: A man stamps out of a room because he felt suffocated.
explanation.definitionFit: Stifled means suffocated or covered so as to stop breathing.

clue.text: I harm northerly state

indicators.note: in a down clue, going north means the words I and harm are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: maim means to injure or harm

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to hurting a northern region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'northerly' turns the whole of I + MAIM in this down clue. The definition is loose: Miami is a city in the state of Florida, not a state.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose definition: a big American place standing for the Florida region it belongs to.

clue.text: When playing hustle detective

indicators.note: when playing suggests the letters of hustle are playing about and rearranged

explanation.surface: An investigator hustles when the game is on.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleuth is a familiar word for a private investigator.

clue.text: Dismiss the person taking the money

definitions.meaning: to discharge someone, especially an officer, in disgrace
a bank or shop clerk at the till

explanation.surface: An order to sack the till operator.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to discharge from the armed forces in disgrace; the noun is a bank teller or shop till worker.

clue.text: Rejected actors on a course

parts.note: the cast is the set of actors in a play
a way is a route or course

explanation.surface: Unwanted performers stay on track.
explanation.definitionFit: A castaway, as an adjective, is something thrown out or discarded.

clue.text: Person who asks earnestly for a lawyer

definitions.meaning: one who solicits, begging or pleading
in Britain, a lawyer who advises clients and prepares cases

explanation.surface: Someone pleading hard to get legal representation.
explanation.definitionFit: One who solicits begs or entreats; in Britain the word is also the title of a legal adviser.

clue.text: Suffer during trendy treatment without a drug

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy

indicators.note: without signals that something is taken away from the remedy

parts.note: a cure is a medical remedy or treatment
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A patient suffers while on a fashionable drug-free therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes E from CURE to leave CUR.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a loss or penalty is to bring it on oneself, to sustain or undergo it.

clue.text: Firmly decide to do a crossword again?

definitions.meaning: to make up one's mind, a verb
a puzzle solved a second time, read as re- plus solve

explanation.surface: A solver vows to tackle the puzzle a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine on a course is the plain sense; the jokey second reads the word as solving once more.

clue.text: Dad lying about gas

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for lying goes around the other piece

parts.note: prone means lying face down
pa is a familiar word for father

explanation.surface: Father fibbing about fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying' looks like fibbing but means flat, PRONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A hydrocarbon fuel, sold bottled for camping stoves.

clue.text: Groups carrying the Spanish picks

indicators.note: carrying means holding, so the groups word goes around the Spanish article

parts.note: sects are factions or groups
el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Factions bearing Spanish-language material make choices.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick is to choose, so both verbs mean making a choice.

clue.text: Book a car — hailstorm's damaged front of Cortina too!

indicators.note: front of picks the opening letter of the next word
damaged suggests these letters are wrecked and rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, with its S

explanation.surface: A car hire customer laments a storm wrecking the front of a Ford Cortina.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cortina was a popular British family car, a Ford. Here the S of 'hailstorm's' is a letter of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A short novel by Dickens, the classic festive ghost story.

clue.text: Tension makes one have second lock added

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Being anxious about an extra hairpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain or pressure, physical or mental.

clue.text: Girl will, if upset, go to mum for paella ingredient

parts.note: she stands for a girl or woman
'll is the short form of will

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word if is read backwards

parts.note: mum, as in keep mum, means quiet: sh

explanation.surface: A girl, if out of sorts, goes to her mother for the rice dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' is not mother but silence, SH.
explanation.definitionFit: Paella is a Spanish rice dish usually containing prawns, mussels and similar seafood.

clue.text: A religious song is able to give pleasure to the audience

indicators.note: to the audience means as heard by listeners, a sound-alike

parts.note: can tickle: is able, can, and give pleasure, tickle

explanation.surface: A hymn that entertains its listeners.
explanation.definitionFit: A canticle is a hymn or chant with a biblical text, like the Magnificat.

clue.text: Change at Corsica to get somewhere else

indicators.note: change tells the solver to alter the order of the letters of at Corsica

explanation.surface: Advice to leave a Mediterranean island for another destination.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central American country is a different place from Corsica.

clue.text: Relaxed motion of a conductor

definitions.meaning: the downward stroke of a baton marking the first beat of the bar

explanation.surface: An easy-going orchestra leader waving the baton.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means understated or unemotional; the noun is the first, accented beat of a bar.

clue.text: Box, perhaps, to house good eater of slugs

parts.note: box is a shrub often grown as a garden hedge

explanation.surface: A crate used as a home for a garden pest-controller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Box' looks like a container but is the shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiny garden mammal that feeds on slugs and other invertebrates.

clue.text: Strangely, it's a miserable place without being harsh

indicators.note: without means outside, so the miserable place goes around the shuffled letters

parts.note: a hole is a dismal, squalid place

indicators.note: strangely means the letters of it's are rearranged in an odd way

explanation.surface: Life is odd in a gloomy place lacking harshness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: the gloomy place surrounds STI, made by 'Strangely' from the letters of it's.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfriendly and antagonistic, as a harsh reception.

clue.text: New course for 5 down

indicators.note: new shows the letters of course are made anew in a different order

explanation.surface: A fresh route for a marooned sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Defoe's shipwrecked hero, the most famous marooned sailor in fiction.

clue.text: Stone city in Oz?

definitions.meaning: the green capital in The Wizard of Oz

explanation.surface: A gem from the Wizard's land.
explanation.definitionFit: A green gemstone; in Baum's story the Wizard rules from a green city bearing the gem's name.

clue.text: Borders around church are soil

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the word for borders is read backwards

parts.note: rims are edges or borders

explanation.surface: Edges around a church are made of earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soil' is a verb, to stain, not earth.
explanation.definitionFit: To smirch is to stain or sully, a verb sense of soil.

clue.text: Error Harry Potter might make?

definitions.meaning: a mistake in writing a word
a misfired magic charm by the boy wizard

explanation.surface: Wondering what blunder the boy wizard could make.
explanation.definitionFit: A misspelt word is a slip; the joke reads it as a botched magic charm.

clue.text: New slipper always left around? Quite the opposite!

indicators.note: around would put left outside always; the opposite means always goes outside left

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A fresh shoe always left lying about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slipper' is not footwear but a slippery creature; New means young.
explanation.definitionFit: An elver is a young eel, a slippery creature in its early stage.

clue.text: Outstanding evening meal priest left

indicators.note: left means departed, so the priest's letter goes from the meal

parts.note: supper is an evening meal

explanation.surface: An excellent dinner from which the clergyman departed.
explanation.definitionFit: Super means excellent, first-rate.

clue.text: Bill at home starts to video opera that's delayed

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: starts to picks the first letters of the next two words

parts.note: on ice means postponed or delayed

explanation.surface: A charge for recording a late-running opera at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' only links; putting something on ice means delaying it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill is a statement of money owed.

clue.text: Antique piano inside's a copy

indicators.note: inside means placed within, so the piano letter goes in the antique

parts.note: a relic is an antique object surviving from the past
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft

explanation.surface: An old piano turns out to be a reproduction.
explanation.definitionFit: A replica is an exact copy or reproduction.

clue.text: One may attend in this

parts.note: attend means listen: a range within which one can hear

explanation.definitionFit: The range of hearing, within which a listener can pay attention.

clue.text: Party's nearly over in tough place of learning

indicators.note: in means placed inside the word for tough

parts.note: hard means tough

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the shortened party word is read backwards
nearly means without the final letter

parts.note: a rave is a large party

explanation.surface: A party almost done in a rough university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' drops the party word's last letter, 'over' turns the rest round to give VAR, and 'in' sets that within the word for tough.
explanation.definitionFit: Harvard is a famous American university.
